title: Plan Changes, Homesite Transfers and Other Amendments to a Home Purchase Agreement
content:
A Home Purchase Agreement may be amended at the buyer's request on the following terms.

- **Plan or elevation change.** Accepted only while the construction stage is not started, the stage named as the collection's plan change cutoff. It carries the collection's plan change fee and re-prices the agreement at the new plan's base price on the amendment date.
- **Homesite transfer.** A transfer to another homesite within the same community is accepted up to the collection's maximum homesite transfers, carries the collection's homesite transfer fee and re-prices the lot premium. It is accepted only while the construction stage is not started.
- **State gate.** A plan change or homesite transfer is written only while the construction stage is not started. The stage is read from the agreement record.
- **Other buyer-requested amendments** carry the collection's contract amendment fee.
- **Assignment** of the agreement to another person is refused where the collection does not allow assignment.
- **Re-pricing and earnest money.** A change that moves the contract price re-computes the earnest money under the agreement's earnest money terms, and any shortfall is due within the collection's signing deposit business days.

## Stage gate at a glance

| Construction stage on the agreement | Plan or elevation change | Homesite transfer |
|---|---|---|
| Not started | May be written (fee applies) | May be written, within the transfer limit (fee applies) |
| Foundation, framing, drywall, finishes or complete | Not written | Not written |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical agreements)

- A hypothetical agreement at stage not started with no prior transfer, in a collection allowing 1 transfer, may be moved to another homesite in the same community; a second transfer would exceed that collection's limit.
- A hypothetical agreement at the foundation stage cannot take a plan change.
- A plan change from a plan priced 420000.00 to one priced 435000.00 on the amendment date, with a lot premium of 15000.00, re-prices the contract price from 435000.00 to 450000.00; the earnest money is re-computed on 450000.00 and any shortfall is due within the collection's signing deposit business days.
